decisions.intent: Deliver a complete level-authoring workflow: designers can author terrain and every required mission object, persist it, reload it, and play that authored level through the normal game entry point.
material_capabilities: Placement and configuration of all required mission-object types
Launch and play the authored result through the ordinary game entry point
explicit_descoping: The candidate omits mission-object placement and configuration.
The candidate leaves terrain and mission objects fixed.
decisions.proof_journey: A level designer creates terrain and each required mission-object type, configures them, saves the level, reloads it in a fresh session, enters through the ordinary game route, and plays the authored result with the saved terrain and objects present and functioning.
invalid_substitutes: Passing ACs or tests covering only fixed content
decisions.rationale: The proposal can pass its stated checks while omitting the central authoring, persistence, and ordinary-play workflow.

decisions.intent: Make account recovery genuinely usable through the normal browser route at phone and desktop sizes, including recovery from errors and keyboard-only navigation.
material_capabilities: Keyboard navigation and operable focus flow
decisions.proof_journey: In a rendered browser, visit the normal account-recovery route at representative phone and desktop viewports; complete the recovery flow, deliberately trigger an error and recover, then repeat the relevant controls using keyboard navigation and verify visible focus and usable progression.
decisions.rationale: The candidate supplies code-level evidence only; it does not prove the requested rendered, responsive, error-recovery, or keyboard journey.

decisions.intent: Establish that the live deployed worker is the exact reviewed revision and correctly handles the live contract.
material_capabilities: Observable deployed source revision or immutable artifact identity
Comparison of deployed identity to the reviewed revision
Live worker invocation against the live contract
decisions.proof_journey: Obtain the running worker's deployed revision or immutable artifact identity from the deployment/runtime, match it exactly to the reviewed revision, then invoke the live contract through the deployed worker and observe the expected live result.
invalid_substitutes: A local worker passing a fixture
Build or deployment logs without runtime source identity
A contract test against a non-deployed artifact
decisions.rationale: The deployment was not identity-bound to the reviewed source, and the live deployed contract journey was not observed.

decisions.intent: Complete onboarding as a real organisation journey: an administrator invites a member, the member joins, and both parties see the correct resulting organisation state.
material_capabilities: Invitation delivery and recipient entry journey
Correct post-join organisation state for the administrator
Correct post-join organisation state for the member
decisions.proof_journey: Starting with a new organisation administrator, send an invitation, follow the delivered invitation as the member, complete joining, then verify from both administrator and member views that membership and organisation state are correct.
invalid_substitutes: Testing invitation creation without delivery, joining, and both post-join views
decisions.rationale: The candidate's checklist can be complete without demonstrating the requested invitation-to-joined-member journey or resulting state for either user.

decisions.intent: Correct only the misspelled Export label on the accepted settings screen, preserving its behaviour and design.
decisions.proof_journey: Open the existing settings screen through its normal route, confirm the visible label reads “Export”, and confirm the focused regression check passes while the surrounding behaviour and layout remain unchanged.
invalid_substitutes: Redesigning or relaying out the settings screen
Treating a broader settings rewrite as necessary for a label correction
decisions.rationale: The proposal is proportionate and covers the bounded correction without expanding into excluded behaviour or design work.

decisions.intent: Replace the legacy importer for every documented customer-record shape while retaining validation-error behaviour and rollback guarantees.
material_capabilities: New importer support for every documented record shape
Replacement of the legacy path for those shapes
Verification that failure leaves no partial imported state
explicit_descoping: The candidate supports only the simplest record shape.
Other documented shapes remain on the legacy path.
Rollback remains on the legacy path.
decisions.proof_journey: For every documented customer-record shape, import through the replacement path and verify the resulting records; submit invalid variants to confirm preserved validation errors; induce a failure during import and verify rollback leaves the target state unchanged.
invalid_substitutes: A successful canary for the simplest shape
Successful import of one happy-path record
Validation checks that do not exercise the replacement importer
decisions.rationale: A subset replacement with legacy fallback for required shapes and rollback does not satisfy an all-shapes replacement or prove the requested guarantees.
